#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

"""
Generate a comprehensive PowerPoint presentation on India.
Uses python-pptx to create slides with titles, bullet points, charts, and theme colors.
"""

import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE

# Create presentation
prs = Presentation()

# Set slide dimensions for 16:9 widescreen
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.33)  # 13.33 inches = 33.867 cm (16:9)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)   # 7.5 inches = 19.05 cm (16:9)

# Theme colors for 'Tech Innovation' theme
PRIMARY_BLUE = RGBColor(0x00, 0x66, 0xFF)   # #0066FF
SECONDARY_CYAN = RGBColor(0x00, 0xCC, 0xCC) # #00CCCC (approx #00FFFF)
DARK = RGBColor(0x1E, 0x1E, 0x1E)           # #1E1E1E

# Function to add a slide with title and bullet points, optional chart
def add_slide(prs, layout_index, title_text, bullet_points, chart_data=None, chart_type=None):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[layout_index])
    
    # Set slide background to dark color
    fill = slide.background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = DARK
    
    # Title placeholder (usually placeholder 0)
    title_placeholder = slide.shapes.title
    title_placeholder.text = title_text
    title_paragraph = title_placeholder.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
    title_paragraph.font.size = Pt(36)
    title_paragraph.font.bold = True
    title_paragraph.font.color.rgb = PRIMARY_BLUE
    
    # Content placeholder (usually placeholder 1)
    if len(slide.placeholders) > 1:
        content_placeholder = slide.placeholders[1]
        tf = content_placeholder.text_frame
        tf.clear()
        for point in bullet_points:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
            p.text = point
            p.font.size = Pt(20)
            p.font.color.rgb = DARK
            p.level = 0
    # Add chart if provided
    if chart_data:
        # Determine position and size for the chart
        x_offset = Inches(1)
        y_offset = Inches(1.5)
        chart_width = Inches(6)
        chart_height = Inches(3)
        slide.shapes.add_chart(chart_type, x_offset, y_offset, chart_width, chart_height, chart_data)
    
    return slide

# -------------------- Title Slide --------------------
title_slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]  # Title slide layout
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(title_slide_layout)
slide.shapes.title.text = "India: A Comprehensive Overview"
slide.placeholders[1].text = "Exploring Geography, Culture, Economy, and Future"
title_para = slide.shapes.title.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
title_para.font.size = Pt(44)
title_para.font.bold = True
title_para.font.color.rgb = PRIMARY_BLUE
subtitle_para = slide.placeholders[1].text_frame.paragraphs[0]
subtitle_para.font.size = Pt(28)
subtitle_para.font.color.rgb = PRIMARY_BLUE

# -------------------- Geography --------------------
add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,  # Title and Content layout
    title_text="Geography",
    bullet_points=[
        "Location: South Asia, between Pakistan, China, and Bangladesh",
        "Area: 3.29 million km² (7th largest)",
        "Borders: 7 countries, Himalayan range in the north",
        "Major rivers: Ganges, Brahmaputra, Yamuna",
        "Climate: Ranges from tropical to alpine"
    ]
)

# -------------------- Demographics --------------------
add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="Demographics",
    bullet_points=[
        "Population: ~1.44 billion (2023)",
        "Languages: 22 official, Hindi & English widely spoken",
        "Religions: 79% Hindu, 15% Muslim, 2% Christian, 4% Sikh, others",
        "Age structure: 28% aged 0-14, 66% aged 15-64, 6% aged 65+",
        "Urbanization: 35% urban population"
    ]
)

# -------------------- History --------------------
add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="History",
    bullet_points=[
        "Indus Valley Civilization (3300–1300 BCE)",
        "Maurya & Gupta Empires (c. 322 BCE – 1450 CE)",
        "Mughal Empire (1526–1857) – introduced Persian culture",
        "British Raj (1857–1947) – independence movement led by Gandhi",
        "Republic established 1950 – world's largest democracy"
    ]
)

# -------------------- Economy --------------------
# Chart data for sector-wise GDP contribution (approx)
chart_data = CategoryChartData()
chart_data.categories = ['Agriculture', 'Industry', 'Services']
chart_data.add_series('GDP Share', [16, 29, 55])  # percentages

add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="Economy",
    bullet_points=[
        "GDP (nominal): ~$3.5 trillion (2023)",
        "Growth rate: ~7% annual (pre-COVID)",
        "Key sectors: Services (IT, BPO) dominate, Manufacturing rising",
        "Agriculture employs ~42% of workforce"
    ],
    chart_data=chart_data,
    chart_type=XL_CHART_TYPE.COLUMN_CLUSTERED
)

# -------------------- Culture --------------------
add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="Culture",
    bullet_points=[
        "Diversity: 28 states, 8 union territories, 1.3 million mosques",
        "Festivals: Diwali, Holi, Eid, Christmas, Pongal",
        "Cuisine: Diverse – biryani, dosa, thali, street food",
        "Arts: Classical music (Hindustani & Carnatic), dance (Bharatanatyam)",
        "Cinema: Bollywood – world's largest film producer"
    ]
)

# -------------------- Tourism --------------------
add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="Tourism",
    bullet_points=[
        "UNESCO World Heritage Sites: 40+ (Taj Mahal, Jaipur, Kerala backwaters)",
        "Major destinations: Kerala backwaters, Himalayas, Goa beaches, Rajasthan forts",
        "Visitor numbers: ~10 million foreign tourists (pre-pandemic)",
        "Tourism contributes ~6% of GDP"
    ]
)

# -------------------- Science & Technology --------------------
# Chart data for IT services revenue growth (approx)
chart_data_tech = CategoryChartData()
chart_data_tech.categories = ['2018', '2019', '2020', '2021', '2022']
chart_data_tech.add_series('IT Services Revenue (USD B)', [150, 180, 200, 230, 260])

add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="Science & Technology",
    bullet_points=[
        "Space Agency (ISRO) launches satellites, interplanetary missions",
        "IT services exports: ~$200 billion annually",
        "Startup ecosystem: Bengaluru dubbed 'Silicon Valley of India'",
        "Pharma and biotech research growing rapidly"
    ],
    chart_data=chart_data_tech,
    chart_type=XL_CHART_TYPE.LINE
)

# -------------------- Defense --------------------
add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="Defense",
    bullet_points=[
        "3rd largest military by active personnel (~1.4 million)",
        "Nuclear-armed state with triadic deterrent",
        "Indigenous defense production: Tejas fighter, Arjun tank",
        "Strategic partnerships: US, Russia, France, Israel"
    ]
)

# -------------------- Education --------------------
add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="Education",
    bullet_points=[
        "Literacy rate: 77% (2021)",
        "Premier institutions: IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, ISRO",
        "Research output: ~100,000 scientific papers per year",
        "Online education: National Digital Library (NDL) initiative"
    ]
)

# -------------------- Challenges & Future Outlook --------------------
add_slide(
    prs,
    layout_index=1,
    title_text="Challenges & Future Outlook",
    bullet_points=[
        "Challenges: Income inequality, water scarcity, pollution",
        "Renewable energy target: 500 GW by 2030",
        "Vision 2047: $10 trillion economy, top 3 global power",
        "Digital transformation: 5G rollout, AI research initiatives"
    ]
)
